notes: Unlock schedules are read from the GRVTVesting vault contracts on Ethereum, where each allocation vests to a single recipient following a checkpoint schedule.
The airdrop TGE tranche is the 280m allocation minus the amount vesting in the airdrop vault.
The ecosystem allocation will be used for future points seasons, partnerships and growth initiatives.

Team.methodology: 19% of the total supply, allocated to the team. Vests with a 1 year cliff followed by 36 monthly unlocks, read live from the on-chain vesting vault

Investors.methodology: 19.9% of the total supply, allocated to investors. Vests monthly from January 2027 to June 2030, read live from the on-chain vesting vault

Seasons 1 and 2 Airdrop.methodology: 28% of the total supply, allocated to the Seasons 1 and 2 points airdrop. A first tranche was released at TGE and the remainder vests in tranches at months 4, 8 and 12, read live from the on-chain vesting vault. Individual schedules vary by user and unclaimed tranches expire 30 days after release

Ecosystem.methodology: 29.1% of the total supply, reserved for future points seasons, partnerships and ecosystem growth initiatives. Unlocks monthly until June 2030, read live from the on-chain vesting vault

Liquidity.methodology: 4% of the total supply, sent from the treasury to market makers and exchanges around TGE
